params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Teemo}} becomes {{tip|invisible}} after a brief moment remaining idle without taking damage, and will maintain so long as he remains idle or not {{tip|airborne|displaced}}.
params.blurb2: While '''Teemo''' is in {{tip|brush}}, he will gain and maintain stealth even while moving.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Element of Surprise:}} When '''Teemo''' breaks the stealth, he gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} after {{fd|1.5}} seconds without moving, taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage, performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}}, {{tip|channel|channeling}}, or being in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}. '''Teemo''' will maintain stealth so long as he remains idle and is not {{tip|airborne|displaced}}. While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Teemo''' gains the stealth even while moving and can move without breaking stealth, but will lose the stealth in this case if he is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Element of Surprise:}} When '''Teemo''' breaks the stealth, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|1;5;10;15}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Teemo}} shoots a dart at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|blind|blinds}} them for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' shoots a dart at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|blind|blinds}} them for a duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Blind Duration|{{ap|2 to 3}} seconds}}
params.description2: The duration of the {{tip|blind}} is doubled against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* ''Blinding Dart'' will not make abilities that can trigger {{tip|on-hit}} effects ({{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}, {{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}) miss.
* When blinded, enemies have a green tint on their screen.
* Because ''Blinding Dart'' uses {{tip|center range}}, it has 45 to 70 more range than his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}}, which use {{tip|edge range}}, against other {{tip|champions}}.
** This bonus becomes lower if '''Teemo''' or his target have {{tip|size}} bonuses.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Teemo}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after a few seconds without taking damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' doubles the {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time. The passive effect cannot be removed during this time.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 5 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' doubles the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds, preventing it from being removed for the duration.
params.description3: ''Casting Move Quick does not interrupt {{ai|Guerrilla Warfare|Teemo}}.''
params.notes:
* When ''Move Quick's'' active bonus movement speed ends '''Teemo''' will not regain the passive one if he was damaged during the active's duration.
*''Move Quick's'' passive will be disabled even if the damage is blocked with a {{tip|spell shield}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Teemo}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} and inflict {{tip|poison}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target continually takes {{as|magic damage}} over a few seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and inflict {{tip|poison}}.

{{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage On-Hit|{{ap|9 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|6 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Poison Damage|{{ap|6*4.0 to 30*4.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*4.0}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*4.0}}% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Toxic Shot'' deals {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|persistent damage|damage over time}}, and does not trigger {{tip|spell effects}}.
** Despite this, it is special cased to trigger {{ri|Dark Harvest}}, but not {{ri|Cheap Shot}}, {{ri|Conqueror}}, {{bi|Scorchclaw's Slash}}, {{ri|Summon Aery}} and {{bi|Ocean Dragon Soul}}.
* The damage per tick is not updated dynamically based on '''Teemo's''' current ability power.
* The initial hit from ''Toxic Shot'' will consume {{ri|Manaflow Band}} if it is available. 
* The attacks do not affect {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Teemo}} tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} and lasts for a while. It will bounce forward upon landing on another mushroom.
params.blurb2: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a charge of ''Noxious Trap'', up to a cap.
params.blurb3: Mushrooms can be destroyed by enemy {{tip|basic attacks}} and will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting {{tip|poison}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for a few seconds, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over a few seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can {{tt|happen repeatedly|In-flight mushrooms can chain into further bounces if they keep landing on subsequent placed mushrooms}}.
params.description2: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.
params.description3: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting {{tip|poison}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 4 seconds, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them.
params.description4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
params.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|200/4 to 450/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
params.description5: A mushroom has {{sti|health|{{as|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by {{tip|champion}} basic attacks (2 damage from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 from {{tip|melee}}).
params.description6: ''See [[Teemo#Pets|Pets]] for more details about mushroom traps.''
params.notes:
* ''Noxious Trap'' deals {{tip|persistent area damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* The bounce can occur an indefinite amount of times while '''Teemo''' is alive. If '''Teemo''' dies before ''Noxious Trap'' bounces on another, the trap will disappear.
* {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} will not trigger ''Noxious Trap's'' explosion if it is not being attacked.
* Enemies who step on multiple ''Noxious Traps'' will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow.
* ''Noxious Trap's'' damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if '''Teemo's''' {{sti|AP|{{as|ability power}}}} changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all ''Noxious Traps'' so long as they do not explode.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.
